text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Remote XFS: parallelism and copy recipes
Points = means of 3 runs; whiskers = observed min–max.
Curves: rcp copy concurrency settings. Horizontal lines: separate rsync recipes; dashed = scripted 10-process copy.
Tools were measured on equivalent hosts. Automatic rcp limits were not recorded.
The scripted rsync recipe divides the generated top-level directories among 10 processes; this is not a built-in rsync option.
Settings on the x-axis are categories; automatic rcp is shown separately. Sizes are decimal; the 1 kB workload has ~100× fewer bytes.
